name: Gradaly v4.0.0
title: Gradaly v4.0.0
notes:
### ✨ What's New in Gradaly v4.0.0
- **2-in-1 Dual-Mode Architecture (Exam Grading & Practice QR)**: Gradaly now combines two complementary tools in one native desktop app: (1) **Summative Exam Mode** for teachers to grade scanned student copies (100% human, AI-assisted, or in a team), and (2) **Formative Practice & Self-Assessment QR Mode** for students to practice autonomously on paper with their smartphone.
- **Printable QR Exercise Worksheets & Student Smartphone App (BYOK)**: Stamp general and per-question QR codes (`?q=Q1`) onto your PDF exercise sheets. Students solve on paper, scan the QR code, photograph their handwritten work, and receive instant rubric feedback and Reference Solution (`Solutionnaire`) unlocking after their 1st attempt using their own free Google AI Studio (Gemini) key (0 € API cost for the teacher).
- **Built-In Smartphone Simulator (Free) & Zero-Knowledge Publication (Pro)**: Preview and test the mobile student experience directly inside Gradaly for free, and publish encrypted sessions to `portal.gradaly.io` (60/180/365 days) or export standalone `.zip` packages with Gradaly Pro.
- **Split Statement & Answer Zones (`ANSWER_ZONES`) and Reference Solution Zones (`SOLUTION_ZONES`)**: Define separate statement and student answer bounding boxes when questions and answer spaces are on different pages, and draw dedicated bounding boxes on the Reference Solution PDF.
- **Practice Project Sharing & Selective Merge**: Share `.gradaly` archives or encrypted Cloud links and selectively merge rubrics, criteria, and QR settings for Practice projects.
- **4 Built-In Demo Projects (FR & EN)**: Explore `Demo Exam FR`, `Demo Exam EN`, `Demo Entraînement FR`, and `Demo Practice EN` out of the box.
